name: connection
summary: The credential model and the policy that decides what to try next against an institution. A bug here does not produce a wrong number, it produces a FROZEN ACCOUNT — so an auth failure is NEVER retried, a transport failure is, MFA is a handoff rather than an obstacle, a fresh session is the lockout-avoidance mechanism, and the manual file-drop path is always available and always last.
